# Generate Oxygen UI Layout

## Instructions

1. Read `.claude/oxygen-ui/patterns.md` for layout patterns
2. Use `AppShell` as the main wrapper
3. Configure `Header` with navigation
4. Set up `Sidebar` with menu items

<!-- oxygen-ui-rules:start -->
<!-- Generated by `pnpm rules:generate`. Do not edit between these markers. -->

## Oxygen UI rules

Follow these rules (version 0.0.1) in all code you write or change. The Oxygen UI analyzer checks them. `.claude/oxygen-ui/rules.md` has how to fix each one, with examples.

- **Import MUI components from Oxygen UI** (`no-direct-mui-imports`, mandatory): Import MUI components, styles and MUI X namespaces from `@wso2/oxygen-ui`, not from `@mui/*` packages.
- **Import icons from Oxygen UI icons** (`no-direct-lucide-imports`, mandatory): Import icons from `@wso2/oxygen-ui-icons-react`, not from `lucide-react`.
<!-- oxygen-ui-rules:end -->

## Critical Rules

- Always use `OxygenUIThemeProvider` at the root
- Use compound component pattern for `AppShell`, `Header`, `Sidebar`
- Use theme tokens for all styling
- Set a browser tab title on every page using `[Specific page/resource] | [Product]` (see below)
- Write all UI text in sentence case (see below)
- Group sidebar items with section titles and collapsible groups (see below)

## UI Text

Write all titles, action text, and content in sentence case. Capitalize only the first word, proper nouns, product names, and acronyms.

```text
✓ User management    ✓ API keys    ✓ Sign out
✗ User Management    ✗ API Keys    ✗ SIGN OUT
```

- Applies to page titles, headings, navigation items, sidebar categories, header actions, and menu items
- Write the text in sentence case in the source; never change case with `textTransform: 'uppercase'` or `'capitalize'`

## Browser Tab Title

Every page must set a browser tab title in this format, so users can tell tabs, bookmarks, and history entries apart. Render a React 19 `<title>` element in the page component rather than assigning `document.title`:

```text
[Specific page/resource] | [Product]
```

Examples:

```text
All projects | Acme Console
Environments | Acme Console
```

- Put the specific page or resource first and the product name last
- Separate them with ` | ` (space, pipe, space)
- Use the same product name on every page
- On the product home or landing page, use the product name only: `Acme Console`
- For nested resources, go from most to least specific: `Environments | Payments API | Acme Console`
- For dynamic names, use the resource name once it loads; until then show the page type (`Project | Acme Console`), never `Loading...`
- On error pages, name the error: `Page Not Found | Acme Console`

```tsx
function ProjectsPage() {
  return (
    <>
      <title>All projects | Acme Console</title>
      {/* page content */}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Side Panel Navigation

Group sidebar items with section titles and collapsible groups. Titles keep the main areas visible; collapsible groups keep the panel short as items grow.

```text
Section title       Main areas users need to see at a glance      Sidebar.CategoryLabel
Collapsible group   Secondary items, or a parent with sub-pages    Sidebar.Item with nested Sidebar.Item children
```

If users visit an item often, put it under a title. Otherwise, put it in a collapsible group.

Section titles:
- Keep titles short and clear; they are labels only, never clickable
- Limit the number of titled sections; don't give every group a title

Collapsible groups:
- The parent only opens and closes the group; never give it a page or a `link`
- Expand the group that contains the active page by default
- Remember each user's open and closed groups (`Sidebar` does not store this; see below)
- One level of nesting only; never put a collapsible group inside another
- Give child items icons that differ from the parent's icon

General:
- Put Settings, Notifications, and Help in `Sidebar.Footer`, outside the scrolling `Sidebar.Nav`
- Add a menu search when the panel has many items
- Don't mix the rules: titles never toggle, collapsible parents never navigate

```tsx
const storageKey = `side-panel-groups:${userId}`;

const [expandedMenus, setExpandedMenus] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

// Load the user's saved groups on the client, after mount (safe for SSR).
useEffect(() => {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) ?? '{}');
    setExpandedMenus((prev) => ({ ...saved, ...prev }));
  } catch {
    // Storage is unavailable or the saved value is invalid.
  }
}, [storageKey]);

// Open the group that contains the active page whenever it changes.
useEffect(() => {
  if (activeGroupId) {
    setExpandedMenus((prev) => ({ ...prev, [activeGroupId]: true }));
  }
}, [activeGroupId]);

const toggleExpand = (id: string) => {
  setExpandedMenus((prev) => {
    const next = { ...prev, [id]: !prev[id] };
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch {
      // Storage is unavailable.
    }
    return next;
  });
};

<Sidebar
  collapsed={collapsed}
  activeItem={activeItem}
  expandedMenus={expandedMenus}
  onSelect={setActiveItem}
  onToggleExpand={toggleExpand}
>
  <Sidebar.Nav>
    <Sidebar.Category>
      <Sidebar.Item id="home">
        <Sidebar.ItemIcon><Home size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
        <Sidebar.ItemLabel>Home</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
      </Sidebar.Item>
    </Sidebar.Category>

    <Sidebar.Category>
      <Sidebar.CategoryLabel>Build</Sidebar.CategoryLabel>
      <Sidebar.Item id="projects">
        <Sidebar.ItemIcon><FolderOpen size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
        <Sidebar.ItemLabel>Projects</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
      </Sidebar.Item>
      {/* Collapsible group: nest child items inside the parent */}
      <Sidebar.Item id="developer-tools">
        <Sidebar.ItemIcon><Wrench size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
        <Sidebar.ItemLabel>Developer tools</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
        <Sidebar.Item id="api-keys">
          <Sidebar.ItemIcon><KeyRound size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
          <Sidebar.ItemLabel>API keys</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
        </Sidebar.Item>
        <Sidebar.Item id="webhooks">
          <Sidebar.ItemIcon><Webhook size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
          <Sidebar.ItemLabel>Webhooks</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
        </Sidebar.Item>
      </Sidebar.Item>
    </Sidebar.Category>
  </Sidebar.Nav>

  <Sidebar.Footer>
    <Sidebar.Category>
      <Sidebar.Item id="settings">
        <Sidebar.ItemIcon><Settings size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
        <Sidebar.ItemLabel>Settings</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
      </Sidebar.Item>
    </Sidebar.Category>
  </Sidebar.Footer>
</Sidebar>
```

## Complete App Shell Layout

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  OxygenUIThemeProvider,
  OxygenTheme,
  AppShell,
  Header,
  Sidebar,
  Footer,
  Box,
  ColorSchemeToggle,
  UserMenu,
} from '@wso2/oxygen-ui';
import {
  HomeIcon,
  DashboardIcon,
  SettingsIcon,
  UsersIcon,
  FileIcon,
} from '@wso2/oxygen-ui-icons-react';

function ProjectsPage() {
  return (
    <>
      <title>All projects | My Application</title>
      {/* Page content goes here */}
      <h1>All projects</h1>
    </>
  );
}

function App() {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState('home');

  return (
    <OxygenUIThemeProvider theme={OxygenTheme}>
      <AppShell>
        <AppShell.Navbar>
          <Header>
            <Header.Toggle
              collapsed={collapsed}
              onToggle={() => setCollapsed(!collapsed)}
            />
            <Header.Brand>
              <Header.BrandLogo>
                <img src="/logo.svg" alt="Logo" height={32} />
              </Header.BrandLogo>
              <Header.BrandTitle>My Application</Header.BrandTitle>
            </Header.Brand>
            <Header.Spacer />
            <Header.Actions>
              <ColorSchemeToggle />
              <UserMenu
                user={{ name: 'John Doe', email: 'john@example.com' }}
                onSignOut={() => console.log('Sign out')}
              />
            </Header.Actions>
          </Header>
        </AppShell.Navbar>

        <AppShell.Sidebar>
          <Sidebar
            collapsed={collapsed}
            activeItem={activeItem}
            onSelect={setActiveItem}
          >
            <Sidebar.Nav>
              <Sidebar.Category>
                <Sidebar.CategoryLabel>Main</Sidebar.CategoryLabel>
                <Sidebar.Item id="home">
                  <Sidebar.ItemIcon><HomeIcon size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
                  <Sidebar.ItemLabel>Home</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
                </Sidebar.Item>
                <Sidebar.Item id="dashboard">
                  <Sidebar.ItemIcon><DashboardIcon size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
                  <Sidebar.ItemLabel>Dashboard</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
                </Sidebar.Item>
              </Sidebar.Category>

              <Sidebar.Category>
                <Sidebar.CategoryLabel>Management</Sidebar.CategoryLabel>
                <Sidebar.Item id="users">
                  <Sidebar.ItemIcon><UsersIcon size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
                  <Sidebar.ItemLabel>Users</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
                  <Sidebar.ItemBadge>12</Sidebar.ItemBadge>
                </Sidebar.Item>
                <Sidebar.Item id="files">
                  <Sidebar.ItemIcon><FileIcon size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
                  <Sidebar.ItemLabel>Files</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
                </Sidebar.Item>
              </Sidebar.Category>
            </Sidebar.Nav>

            <Sidebar.Footer>
              <Sidebar.Item id="settings">
                <Sidebar.ItemIcon><SettingsIcon size={20} /></Sidebar.ItemIcon>
                <Sidebar.ItemLabel>Settings</Sidebar.ItemLabel>
              </Sidebar.Item>
            </Sidebar.Footer>
          </Sidebar>
        </AppShell.Sidebar>

        <AppShell.Main>
          <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>
            <ProjectsPage />
          </Box>
        </AppShell.Main>

        <AppShell.Footer>
          <Footer companyName="WSO2 LLC" />
        </AppShell.Footer>
      </AppShell>
    </OxygenUIThemeProvider>
  );
}

export default App;
```

## Header with Context Switchers

```tsx
<Header>
  <Header.Toggle collapsed={collapsed} onToggle={toggleSidebar} />
  <Header.Brand>
    <Header.BrandLogo><Logo /></Header.BrandLogo>
    <Header.BrandTitle>App Name</Header.BrandTitle>
  </Header.Brand>

  <Header.Switchers>
    <OrganizationSwitcher />
    <ProjectSwitcher />
  </Header.Switchers>

  <Header.Spacer />

  <Header.Actions>
    <SearchBar />
    <NotificationButton />
    <ColorSchemeToggle />
    <UserMenu user={user} />
  </Header.Actions>
</Header>
```

## Minimal Header (No Switchers)

```tsx
<Header minimal>
  <Header.Brand>
    <Header.BrandTitle>Simple App</Header.BrandTitle>
  </Header.Brand>
  <Header.Spacer />
  <Header.Actions>
    <ColorSchemeToggle />
  </Header.Actions>
</Header>
```

## Dashboard Layout with Stats

```tsx
import { Grid, Paper, Typography, Box } from '@wso2/oxygen-ui';

function DashboardContent() {
  return (
    <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>Dashboard</Typography>

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} md={3}>
          <Paper sx={{ p: 3 }}>
            <Typography color="text.secondary" variant="body2">Total users</Typography>
            <Typography variant="h4" fontWeight="bold">12,345</Typography>
          </Paper>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} md={3}>
          <Paper sx={{ p: 3 }}>
            <Typography color="text.secondary" variant="body2">Revenue</Typography>
            <Typography variant="h4" fontWeight="bold">$45,678</Typography>
          </Paper>
        </Grid>
        {/* More stats... */}
      </Grid>
    </Box>
  );
}
```
